raw_segments.text: First, no more than any other hypothesis, for when the people are made miserable and
find themselves exposed to the ill usage of arbitrary power, cry up their governors as
much as you will for sons of Jupiter.
Let them be sacred and divine, descended, or authorized from heaven.
Give them out for whom or what you please, the same will happen.
The people generally ill-treated and contrary to right will be ready upon any occasion to
ease themselves of a burden that sits heavy upon them.
They will wish and seek for the opportunity, which in the change, weakness, and accidents
of human affairs seldom delays long to offer itself.
He must have lived but a little while in the world, who has not seen examples of this in
his time, and he must have read very little, who cannot produce examples of it in all sorts
